questions.question: If the 9-digit number 7x79251y8 is divisible by 36, What is the value of (10x² - 3y²) for the largest possible value of y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The 9-digit number = 7x79251y8

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 4:** If the last two digits of the number are divisible by 4 then the number is divisible by 4

**Divisibility rule of 9:** If the sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 9 then the number is also divisible by 9

**Calculation:**

The given 9-digit number = 7x79251y8

y8 needs to be divisible by 4

If y = 8 (largest value) then y8 = 88 → Divisible by 4

Now, the number = 7x7925188

Here, (7 + x + 7 + 9 + 2 + 5 + 1 + 8 + 8) be divisible by 9

⇒ (47 + x) be divisible by 9

Put x = 7

⇒ (47 + x) = 47 + 7 = 54 → Divisible by 9

So, x = 7; y = 8

Then, (10x2 - 3y2) = 10 × (7)² - 3 × (8)²

= 10 × 49 - 3 × 64

= 490 - 192

= 298

**∴ The value of (10x2 - 3y2) is 298**

questions.question: The average of five numbers is 30. If one number is excluded, then average becomes 31. What is the excluded number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of five numbers = 30

The average of four numbers = 31

**Concept used:**

The sum of the terms = Average × Number of the terms

**Calculation:**

The excluded number = (30 × 5) - (31 × 4)

= 150 - 124

= 26

**∴ The excluded number is 26**

questions.question: In Δ ABC, D is a point on side BC such that ∠ADC = ∠BAC. If CA = 12 cm, CD = 8 cm, then CB (in cm) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ADC = ∠BAC

CA = 12 cm; CD = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

If Two triangles are similar then, their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are within the same ratio (or proportion).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4775696f2a04b87e18b9ff4bc97d05fe27f23e4cc1b84069c836b19917cd60c.png]

∠BAC = ∠ADC

∴ ∠ABC = ∠DAC

Then, CB/AC = AC/DC (Concept used)

⇒ CB/12 = 12/8

⇒ CB = (12 × 12)/8 = 18 cm

**∴ The value of CB (in cm) is 18 cm**

questions.question: A tea seller used to make 50% of profit by selling tea at ₹9 per cup. When the cost of ingredients increased by 25%, he started selling tea at ₹10 per cup. What is his profit percentage now?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial profit = 50%

The initial selling price of a cup of tea = ₹ 9

The final selling price of a cup of tea = ₹ 10

**Formula used:**

Cost price = 100/(100 + Profit%) × (Selling price)

Profit% = (Profit/Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Here, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

Initial C.P. = 100/(100 + 50) × 9 = (100/150) × 9 = ₹ 6

Final C.P. = 6 × (125/100) = ₹ 7.5

The profit percentage = (10 - 7.5)/7.5 × 100 = (2.5/7.5) × 100 = 33(1)/(3)%

**∴ The percentage of the tea seller is 33(1)/(3)%**

questions.question: Simple interest on a certain sum is one-fourth of the sum and the interest rate percentage per annum is 4 times the number of years. If the rate of interest increases by 2%, then what will be the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹5,000 for 3 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, Amount = 1 then simple interest = 1/4

The rate of interest = R then, time = R/4 years

Now, 1/4 = [1 × R × (R/4)]/100

⇒ 1/4 = R2/400

⇒ R2 = 100

⇒ R = √100 = 10%

∴ The rate of interest = 10%

The new rate of interest = 10 + 2 = 12%

Total interest for 3 years = 3 × 12 = 36%

∴ The total simple interest = (36/100) × 5000 = 1800

∴ The simple interest (in ₹) is ₹1800

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The simple interest = one-fourth of the sum

The rate of interest = 4 times the number of years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (p × r × t)/100

Where, p = The sum of the amount

r = Rate of interest

t = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Let, the sum of the amount = P

The rate of interest = R%

So, the time = R/4 years

Then, P/4 = [P × R × (R/4)]/100

⇒ P/4 = (P × R × R)/400

⇒ 1 = R²/100

⇒ R2 = 100

⇒ R = √100 = 10%

∴ The rate of interest = 10%

The new rate of interest = 10 + 2 = 12%

Now, the simple interest = (5000 × 12 × 3)/100 = 1800

**∴ The simple interest (in ₹) is ₹1800**

questions.question: If the length of a diagonal of a square is (a + b), then the area of the square is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of a diagonal of a square = (a + b)

**Formula used:**

Diagonal of a square = √2 Side

Area of a square = (Side)²

**Calculation:**

Side of the square = Diagonal of a square/√2 

⇒ Side of the square = (a + b)/√2 

The area of the square = [(a + b)/√2]²

= (a + b)²/2

= (a² + b² + 2ab)/2

= (a2 + b2)/2 + ab

**∴ The area of the square is 1/2 (a2 + b2) + ab.**

questions.question: If 4 men and 6 boys can do a work in 8 days and 6 men and 4 boys can do the same work in 7 days, then how many days will 5 men and 4 boys take to do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4 men and 6 boys can do a work in 8 days

6 men and 4 boys can do the same work in 7 days

**Concept used:**

Time = Work/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let, M = Men; B = Boys

(4M + 6B) × 8 = (6M + 4B) × 7

⇒ 32M + 48B = 42M + 28B

⇒ 42M - 32M = 48B - 28B

⇒ 10M = 20B

⇒ M/B = 2/1

So, the efficiency of one man = 2

Efficiency of one boy = 1

Total work = [(4 × 2) + (6 × 1)] × 8 = 14 × 8 = 112

Efficiency of 5 men and 4 boys = (5 × 2) + (4 × 1) = 10 + 4 = 14

Required time to finish the work = 112/14 = 8 days

**∴ The 5 men and 4 boys will take 8 days to do the same work**
